headers.//: Default hardening: clickjacking-protect everything EXCEPT the partner-iframe widget routes (/embed/<widget>). The /embed docs page itself stays protected because the negative-lookahead matches `embed/` (with trailing slash), so only sub-paths are exempted.
Partner-iframe widgets must be embeddable from any origin. Keep nosniff + a stricter Referrer-Policy (no-referrer) so the widget can't leak the host page URL back to our api logs.
